# Statement 1 — Liam Carter
My name is Liam Carter. I am 27 years old.
On Tuesday, I went to the bank with my brother, Noah.
We got there at about 3:10 in the afternoon.
Noah had a black gun. He brought it from his house.
I did not have a gun. I had a blue bag.
Noah said, "Everyone get on the floor."
I said, "Please do what he says. Nobody will get hurt."
The woman behind the desk was scared. She put money in my bag.
The security guard came towards us.
Noah pointed his gun at the guard.
The guard stopped. Nobody fired a gun.
Noah took the bag from me and ran out of the back door.
I tried to leave by the front door.
The police caught me outside the bank at about 3:20 pm.
I told the police that Noah had planned the robbery.
I know Noah will say he was somewhere else.
That is not true.
He was with me at the bank.
I am telling the truth.
# Statement 2 — Noah Carter
My name is Noah Carter. I am 30 years old.
Liam is my younger brother.
I did not rob the bank.
On Tuesday, I was at the supermarket with my girlfriend, Emma.
We got there just before 3:00 pm.
We stayed until about 3:35 pm.
I did not go to the bank that afternoon.
Liam had shown me a silver gun that morning.
He said he had bought it himself.
Liam told me he wanted money.
I told him not to do anything stupid.
After the robbery, I heard that Liam had gone into the bank alone.
I was told that Liam shouted, "Give me all the money."
I also heard that Liam fired his gun at the ceiling.
The guard fell to the floor because he was frightened.
Liam is lying about me.
I never had a black gun.
I never carried a blue bag.
Emma can prove I was at the supermarket.
I did not help Liam rob the bank.
# Statement 3 — Emma Price
My name is Emma Price. I am 28 years old.
Noah Carter is my boyfriend.
I know his brother Liam.
On Tuesday, I went shopping at the supermarket.
Noah came with me.
Liam came with us too.
We all arrived at about 3:00 pm.
We went in together.
I remember Liam getting a shopping basket.
Noah wanted bread and milk.
Liam wanted some drinks.
We walked around the shop together.
At about 3:15 pm, all three of us were standing near the drinks.
Noah said, "We should get some bread."
Liam said, "I will get it."
He came back with two loaves.
None of us had a gun.
Liam did not have a blue bag.
I paid for the shopping at about 3:25 pm.
We all left the supermarket together at about 3:35 pm.
Nobody left the shop while we were shopping.
I do not understand how Liam could have robbed a bank at 3:15 pm.
He was standing next to me.
I remember it clearly.
I am sure all three of us were together.
# Official record — Police arrest record
Police officers arrested Liam Carter outside the supermarket at 3:20 pm on Tuesday.
